title: Reinforcement learning, network causality and the synthesis project
summary: Neuromatch W3D4 and W3D5: temporal-difference learning and prediction, bandits and exploration, Q-learning and model-based planning; then causality in networks, interventions versus correlations, simultaneous regression and instrumental variables; closing with the synthesis-week project in which the learner fits a chosen model to synthetic data of known structure and writes up what it does and does not show.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the source material is Neuromatch W3D4 (Tutorials 1–4) and W3D5 (Tutorials 1–4), with the synthesis project (assessment a4) attached.

preparation.description: W3D4 Reinforcement Learning chapter page: Tutorial 1 Learning to Predict, Tutorial 2 Multi-Armed Bandits, Tutorial 3 Q-Learning, Tutorial 4 Model-Based Reinforcement Learning.
W3D5 Network Causality chapter page: Tutorial 1 Interventions, Tutorial 2 Correlations, Tutorial 3 Simultaneous fitting/regression, Tutorial 4 Instrumental Variables.

activities.instructions: Work through the W3D4 and W3D5 tutorials from the chapter pages; this unit spans two Neuromatch days plus the synthesis week. The prepared lesson, exercises and project guidance are not yet written; this outline shows exactly what the unit will cover. The individual tutorial pages have not yet been opened by Corniversity, so the chapter pages are the verified locators.

activities.instructions: The synthesis project will ask you to choose one model from units 5–10, generate synthetic data from a known version of it, fit it, compare with a baseline, show a failure case and write up the scope honestly.
